# Targets whose right-reason-red rejection on classification=pass is waived,
# one target path per line, then the issue that owns the fix.
#
# The gate requires a changed test to be red at the merge base for a genuine
# assertion, because a test that was already green proves nothing about the
# behaviour the change claims to add.  A de-flaking fix can never satisfy that.
# The bug it repairs is intermittent by definition, so the base run is red only
# on some runs and the gate sees classification=pass.  Without this file the fix
# for a flake is permanently unlandable and the flake stays.
#
# A waiver softens exactly one verdict: the classification=pass rejection, for
# the one target named.  Every other failure class is still rejected, and the
# revert-probe gate does not read this file at all.  So an entry can absorb a
# green test and nothing else, which is the same discipline as the intermittent
# ledger in split-root-known-flaky.txt.
#
# Every entry carries its owning issue, and the issue carries the measurement
# that proves the flake was real and that the fix removed it.  An entry with no
# issue is a parse error rather than a comment, because an unowned waiver is how
# a permanent exemption gets in.  Delete the entry in the pull request that
# closes its issue.
#
#   #639  3/30 failures under CPU contention, 0/40 idle, 0/60 after the fix.
runtime/agent-fabric/tests/unit/provider-interface-conformance.unit.test.ts #639
